# Core Test orders, the pickers and the submits (census #58-#62; the hosts are test-orders-template.txt).
# static/pages/test-orders.js as served: its writes go through the HTTP door (send), so any
# refusal is one sentence, a body that is not JSON included.

== the node fields (shared/node-picker.js over #page-data's list, rule: robot, disabled)
  [ZONE-1]
    "GRP-A" | GRP-A · group
      "GRP-A-L1" | GRP-A-L1 · lane
      "GRP-A-L1-S1" | ↳ GRP-A-L1-S1
      "GRP-A-L1-S2" | ↳ GRP-A-L1-S2
    "OLD-SLOT" | OLD-SLOT  (off: disabled)
  [ZONE-2]
    "GRP-B" | GRP-B · group
      "GRP-B-N1" | GRP-B-N1
      "GRP-B-N2" | GRP-B-N2
    "GRP-OFF" | GRP-OFF · group  (off: disabled)
      "GRP-OFF-N1" | GRP-OFF-N1
    "LINE-1" | LINE-1 · Line one
  [Other]
    "SPOT-9" | SPOT-9
    "VIRT-1" | VIRT-1 · synthetic
    "_ROBOT:AMR-01" | _ROBOT:AMR-01 · robot  (off: a robot, not a place)
  cx-full-source: the same rows, placeholder "Core Decides"
  cx-location: the same rows, placeholder "-- select --"
  cx-outgoing: the same rows, placeholder "Core Decides"
  cx-staging1: the same rows, placeholder "-- select --"
  cx-staging2: the same rows, placeholder "-- select --"
  d-from-node: the same rows, valued by node id, placeholder "-- select --"
  d-to-node: the same rows, valued by node id, placeholder "-- select --"
  k-delivery-node: the same rows, placeholder "-- select --"
  k-source-node: the same rows, placeholder "-- select --"
  kc-full-source: the same rows, placeholder "Core Decides"
  kc-location: the same rows, placeholder "-- select --"
  kc-outgoing: the same rows, placeholder "Core Decides"
  kc-staging1: the same rows, placeholder "-- select --"
  kc-staging2: the same rows, placeholder "-- select --"
One builder for both pages (the Go/JS twins are gone): the same rows as the Orders page's manual order: yes

== the payload fields (shared/part-picker.js)
  "PART-A" | PART-A · Part A
  "PART-B" | PART-B · Part B
  "PART-C" | PART-C · Part C
  kc-payload: the same rows, placeholder "-- optional --"
  cx-payload: the same rows, placeholder "-- optional --"

== the body each pick sends (an answer of 200)
-- Kafka order: move GRP-A -> LINE-1, PART-A
  POST /api/test-orders/submit {"order_type":"move","source_node":"GRP-A","delivery_node":"LINE-1","payload_code":"PART-A","quantity":1,"priority":0}
  GET /api/test-orders
  toast info: Order submitted: u-1
-- Kafka order, no payload
  (no request)
  toast info: Payload is required
-- Kafka complex, two_robot at GRP-A-L1-S1, staging SPOT-9, out GRP-B, source "Core Decides"
  POST /api/test-orders/submit/complex {"cycle_mode":"two_robot","location":"GRP-A-L1-S1","payload_code":"PART-A","inbound_source":"","inbound_staging":"SPOT-9","outbound_staging":"","outbound_destination":"GRP-B","priority":0}
  GET /api/test-orders
  timers: 10, 6000 ms
  showToast to-toast to-toast-info: Kafka complex order published: swap: u-2
-- Direct order: from GRP-B-N1 (id 6) to LINE-1 (id 8)
  POST /api/test-orders/direct {"from_node_id":6,"to_node_id":8,"priority":0}
  GET /api/test-orders/direct
  toast info: Direct order dispatched: v-1
-- Direct order, no "to"
  (no request)
  toast info: Select both from and to nodes
-- Direct complex, the same five as the Kafka one
  POST /api/test-orders/direct/complex {"cycle_mode":"two_robot","location":"GRP-A-L1-S1","payload_code":"PART-A","inbound_source":"","inbound_staging":"SPOT-9","outbound_staging":"","outbound_destination":"GRP-B","priority":0}
  GET /api/test-orders/direct
  timers: 10, 6000 ms
  showToast to-toast to-toast-info: Complex order created: swap: u-3

== refusals: Kafka order
-- test-orders.submit.400: 400 "{\"error\":\"payload_code is required\"}"
  POST /api/test-orders/submit {"order_type":"move","source_node":"GRP-A","delivery_node":"LINE-1","payload_code":"PART-A","quantity":1,"priority":0}
  toast error: payload_code is required
-- json.400: 400 "{\"error\":\"refused: the service's sentence\"}"
  POST /api/test-orders/submit {"order_type":"move","source_node":"GRP-A","delivery_node":"LINE-1","payload_code":"PART-A","quantity":1,"priority":0}
  toast error: refused: the service's sentence
-- auth.401: 401 "{\"error\":\"unauthorized\"}"
  POST /api/test-orders/submit {"order_type":"move","source_node":"GRP-A","delivery_node":"LINE-1","payload_code":"PART-A","quantity":1,"priority":0}
  toast error (sticky): Signed out
-- json.500: 500 "{\"error\":\"failed: the store's error\"}"
  POST /api/test-orders/submit {"order_type":"move","source_node":"GRP-A","delivery_node":"LINE-1","payload_code":"PART-A","quantity":1,"priority":0}
  toast error: failed: the store's error
-- proxy.502: 502 "<html><body>502 Bad Gateway</body></html>"
  POST /api/test-orders/submit {"order_type":"move","source_node":"GRP-A","delivery_node":"LINE-1","payload_code":"PART-A","quantity":1,"priority":0}
  toast error: Server error (502)
-- fetch rejects (TypeError: Failed to fetch)
  POST /api/test-orders/submit {"order_type":"move","source_node":"GRP-A","delivery_node":"LINE-1","payload_code":"PART-A","quantity":1,"priority":0}
  toast error: No answer from the server

  timers: 10, 6000 ms
